theorem lg_target (p : NNReal) (h : p ≤ 1) : PMF.bernoulli p h true = (p : ENNReal) := by
  rw [PMF.to_ennreal, ENNReal.ofReal_coe_nnreal]
  constructor
  · intro q
    exact le_rfl
  · intro h'
    rw [ENNReal.coe_le_iff]
    constructor
    · intro q
      exact le_rfl
    · intro q
      exact h
